chunks.title: Chunks
chunks.description: RAG-ready markdown chunks for embedding models and vector database ingestion.

content.title: Content
content.description: Chunk text content to send to your embedding model.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Header hierarchy metadata, typically keys such as Header 1, Header 2, and Header 3.

chunk_id.title: Chunk ID
chunk_id.description: Stable identifier for idempotent upserts, deduplication, and cache keys in downstream vector workflows.

char_count.title: Character Count
char_count.description: Number of characters in the chunk content.

token_count.title: Estimated Token Count
token_count.description: Approximate token count for embedding budget planning, based on roughly 1 token per 4 characters.

input_mode.title: Input Mode
input_mode.description: Input source mode used for this run.

input_file_type.title: Input File Type
input_file_type.description: Detected MIME type of the source file, or text/markdown for direct text input.

input_chars.title: Input Character Count
input_chars.description: Total source markdown length in characters.

elapsed_ms.title: Elapsed Milliseconds
elapsed_ms.description: Total processing time in milliseconds from input parsing to dataset push.
